title: Journal v2: schema-validated, indexed, replayable event log
summary: The journal module is split into five files and grows from a single hash-chained buffer into a validated event store. Events now carry a typed actor (harness/person/system), an optional work item and change, and a cost; every event is checked against a JSON Schema before a byte is written, and a run-complete event must name the journal's current head. The buffer directory becomes runs/, a per-work-item index under index/ records which runs belong to which work item behind a file lock, and a new reader replays a run, verifying every link and computing a replay digest over decision fields only. The checkpoint runner and review runner are updated to the new actor type and the new Verification fields; CI and the integration tests follow the directory rename.

nodes.label: Checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: osf verify --checkpoint
nodes.summary: Runs the checkpoint's moon tasks and writes one verification event per task plus one checkpoint-complete event. Now builds its actor with Actor::system("osf") and fills the new check_type and summary fields.

nodes.label: Review runner
nodes.subtitle: review_run::reduce_with
nodes.summary: Writes one review-answer event per judged attempt and one review-decision event per review. Updated to pass an Actor value rather than a bare string.

nodes.label: Journal writer
nodes.subtitle: Journal::append / append_draft
nodes.summary: Opens <state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl, validates the draft against the event schema, records the run in the work-item index on the first accepted event, and refuses any event after run-complete. A refused event writes no byte and leaves the head unchanged.

nodes.label: Event model
nodes.subtitle: event.rs
nodes.summary: The envelope and every payload: Actor, Cost, EvidenceGrade, Severity, WorkItemState, BlockedCause, RunOutcome, and the ten event types including the new run-started, review, finding, state-change, run-complete and attention.

nodes.label: Event schema
nodes.subtitle: event.schema.json
nodes.summary: Draft 2020-12 schema for one event envelope, with per-event-type payload branches and cross-field rules: a harness actor must name a model, a blocked state change must carry a cause, and only observed evidence may name a verifier.

nodes.label: Schema validator
nodes.subtitle: schema::validate
nodes.summary: Compiles the event schema once into a process-wide OnceLock and returns one reason string per problem, each naming the JSON path.

nodes.label: Hash chain
nodes.subtitle: hash.rs
nodes.summary: Computes the chain hash over prev_hash, the canonical JSON of payload, work item, change, actor and cost, and the replay digest over decision lines only, dropping timings, cache outcomes, cost, run ids and transcripts.

nodes.label: Journal reader
nodes.subtitle: reader::read_run
nodes.summary: Reads a run back, checking each line against the schema and the chain before returning anything, and reports the head hash, the replay digest and whether the run completed. A broken chain is an error, never a partial list.

nodes.label: Run index
nodes.subtitle: index::record_run
nodes.summary: Appends a run id to its work item's index file under a file lock, writing through a temporary file renamed over the target so a reader never sees a half-written index.

nodes.label: runs/
nodes.subtitle: <state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: One hash-chained JSONL file per run. Renamed from buffer/; the run id is validated as a safe single path component before the file is opened.

nodes.label: index/
nodes.subtitle: <state_dir>/index/<sha256>.json
nodes.summary: One JSON file per work item, named by the SHA-256 hex of the provider-qualified work item id, listing that work item's run ids in recorded order, with a .lock file beside it.

nodes.label: CI workflow
nodes.subtitle: checkpoint-evidence artifact
nodes.summary: The checkpoint-evidence artifact now uploads $OSF_STATE_DIR/runs instead of $OSF_STATE_DIR/buffer.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The checkpoint runner is the main writer: one verification event per task and one checkpoint-complete event per run, now with a typed actor and the new optional fields.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The review runner writes review-answer and review-decision events through the same writer.

edges.label: validate(event)
edges.summary: Every draft is serialised to JSON and validated before the line is written; a failure returns the reasons and writes nothing.

edges.label: include_str!
edges.summary: The schema is embedded in the binary at compile time and compiled once on first use.

edges.label: event_hash(HashInput)
edges.summary: The writer computes the chain hash from the previous head and the draft's replay-relevant parts.
The writer builds the Event envelope from the event model's types.

edges.label: record_run(work_item, run)
edges.summary: The first accepted event of a run records the run in its work item's index before any journal line is written, so a failed index update refuses the event.

edges.label: one JSON line
edges.summary: Each accepted event is appended as one JSON line with a trailing newline.

edges.label: atomic rename
edges.summary: The index is written to a temporary sibling and renamed over the target while the lock is held.

edges.label: read_to_string
edges.summary: The reader loads the run's file and checks every line in order.
Each line is validated against the same schema the writer used before it is accepted.

edges.label: event_hash + ReplayDigest
edges.summary: The reader recomputes each event's hash and mixes its decision line into the replay digest.

edges.label: artifact upload
edges.summary: The checkpoint-evidence artifact path follows the directory rename.
